metadata.title: chore(testing): set up Pact contract testing with pact-python
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- Add consumer-driven contract testing using **pact-python v3** to validate API interactions between the Gateway and MCP servers/clients
- **7 consumer tests** covering MCP protocol interactions: `initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, `resources/list`, `resources/read`, `prompts/list`, `prompts/get`
- **9 provider tests** verifying Gateway APIs: tools/resources/prompts/servers/gateways CRUD + pact file verification
- **6 Makefile targets**: `pact-install`, `pact-consumer`, `pact-provider`, `pact-all`, `pact-publish`, `pact-clean`
- **GitHub Actions workflow** (`pact.yml`) with consumer test job (generates + uploads pact artifacts) and provider verification job
- Pact tests excluded from default `make test` runs via `PYTEST_IGNORE` and `addopts`

Closes #281

## Test plan
- [x] `make pact-consumer` generates valid V4 pact files in `pacts/`
- [x] `make pact-provider` verifies Gateway APIs against contracts
- [x] All 15 pact tests pass (7 consumer + 8 provider)
- [x] Existing 14,827 tests unaffected (pact tests excluded from default runs)
- [x] `make help` shows new pact targets
- [x] CI workflow triggers on `tests/pact/**` and `mcpgateway/**` changes

commits.message:
chore(testing): set up Pact contract testing with pact-python

Add consumer-driven contract testing using pact-python v3 to validate
API interactions between the Gateway and MCP servers/clients.

- Add pact-python dependency and pact pytest marker
- Consumer tests: initialize, tools/list, tools/call, resources/list,
  resources/read, prompts/list, prompts/get (7 tests)
- Provider tests: tools/resources/prompts/servers/gateways CRUD and
  pact file verification (9 tests)
- Makefile targets: pact-install, pact-consumer, pact-provider,
  pact-all, pact-publish, pact-clean
- GitHub Actions workflow with consumer and provider verification jobs
- Pact tests excluded from default test runs

Closes #281

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
